reference.question: \(a=(1,2,k)\) and \(b=(2,4,6)\) are collinear. What is \(k\)?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Use proportional coordinates

The coordinates are proportional: \(1/2=2/4=k/6\), so \(k=3\).
